title: Subanen languages - Wikipedia
text: Most speakers of Subanen languages go by the name of Subanen, Subanon or Subanun, while those who adhere to Islam refer to themselves as Kolibugan, Kalibugan, Tewlet or Telet.

title: Subanon people - Wikipedia
text: The Subanon (also spelled Subanen or Subanun) are an indigenous peoples of the Zamboanga peninsula area, particularly living in the mountainous areas of Zamboanga del Norte, Zamboanga del Sur, and Misamis Occidental, Mindanao Island, Philippines.

text: The biggest group of lumad is the Subanen (Subanon, Subanun) of Zamboanga del Norte and Zamboanga del Sur. Their vocal music is characterized by chants and different types of songs such as the dionli (love song), buwa (lullaby), and giloy (funeral song), among others.
